📖 How to use

  1. Answer each of the 8 setup questions honestly (yes/no).
  2. Press Check my setup.
  3. Read your score out of 8.
  4. Apply the fix recommendations for every 'no' answer.

❓ Frequently asked questions

How high should my monitor be?

The top of your screen should sit at or just below eye level, about an arm's length away, to keep your neck neutral.

What is the right wrist position?

Your elbows should rest near 90 degrees with wrists straight and floating — not bent up or resting on hard edges.

What does the score mean?

Your score out of 8, one point per healthy habit, plus a tailored fix for every answer you marked 'no'.
